ns2:course.label: Individual and Dual Activities
ns2:course.description: Skills and knowledge essential for leisure-time activities which are classified as individual and dual activities. Prerequisites for each individual or dual activity are provided in the Class Schedule. More than one activity (Sections A through Z) may be taken in the same term.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: There will be a fee assessed for use of Illini Union Bowling Alley.
